\subsubsection{Broadcasting and Shape
Compatibility}\label{broadcasting-and-shape-compatibility}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 📐 Broadcasting: Operations between different shapes}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"📐 Broadcasting Examples:"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# DataFrame with different dimensions}
\NormalTok{sales\_matrix }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(\{}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Jan\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\DecValTok{1000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1500}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2000}\NormalTok{],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Feb\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\DecValTok{1100}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1600}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2100}\NormalTok{], }
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Mar\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\DecValTok{1200}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1700}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2200}\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{\}, index}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Store\_A\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Store\_B\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Store\_C\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{])}

\CommentTok{\# Series for operations}
\NormalTok{monthly\_bonus }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.Series([}\DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{150}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{200}\NormalTok{], index}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Jan\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Feb\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Mar\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{])  }\CommentTok{\# Column{-}wise}
\NormalTok{store\_multiplier }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.Series([}\FloatTok{1.1}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{1.2}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{1.05}\NormalTok{], index}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Store\_A\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Store\_B\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Store\_C\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{])  }\CommentTok{\# Row{-}wise}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"📊 Original Sales Matrix:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(sales\_matrix)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{💰 Monthly Bonus (Series):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(monthly\_bonus)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{📈 Store Multiplier (Series):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(store\_multiplier)}

\CommentTok{\# 🔄 Broadcasting operations}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{✨ Broadcasting Results:"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Add monthly bonus to each column}
\NormalTok{sales\_with\_bonus }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sales\_matrix }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ monthly\_bonus}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"📊 Sales + Monthly Bonus (broadcasting across columns):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(sales\_with\_bonus)}

\CommentTok{\# Multiply each row by store multiplier}
\NormalTok{sales\_adjusted }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sales\_matrix.mul(store\_multiplier, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{)  }\CommentTok{\# axis=0 for row{-}wise}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{📊 Sales × Store Multiplier (broadcasting across rows):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(sales\_adjusted.}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{))}
\end{Highlighting}

\subsection{Error Handling and Edge
Cases}\label{error-handling-and-edge-cases}

Common issues and solutions when working with arithmetic operations

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🚨 Handling common arithmetic errors and edge cases}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🛡️ Error Handling and Edge Cases:"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Create data with potential issues}
\NormalTok{problematic\_data }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(\{}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Values\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{, }\OperatorTok{{-}}\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{, }\VariableTok{None}\NormalTok{, }\BuiltInTok{float}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}inf\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Divisors\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Mixed\_Types\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}10\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{20}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}30\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{40}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}50\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]  }\CommentTok{\# Mixed string/numeric}
\NormalTok{\})}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"⚠️ Problematic Data:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(problematic\_data)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"Data types:}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{problematic\_data}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{dtypes}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# 🔧 Issue 1: Division by zero}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{❌ Division by Zero Issue:"}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{try}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{    result }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ problematic\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Values\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ problematic\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Divisors\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"Result with division by zero:"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(result)}
\ControlFlowTok{except} \PreprocessorTok{Exception} \ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ e:}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"Error: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{e}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# ✅ Solution: Handle division by zero}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{✅ Safe Division:"}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{safe\_division }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ problematic\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Values\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].div(problematic\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Divisors\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]).replace([}\BuiltInTok{float}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}inf\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{), }\BuiltInTok{float}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}{-}inf\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)], }\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(safe\_division)}

\CommentTok{\# 🔧 Issue 2: Mixed data types}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{❌ Mixed Data Types Issue:"}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{try}\NormalTok{:}
    \CommentTok{\# Convert string column to numeric first}
\NormalTok{    mixed\_numeric }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.to\_numeric(problematic\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Mixed\_Types\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], errors}\OperatorTok{=}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}coerce\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"Converted mixed types:"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(mixed\_numeric)}
    
    \CommentTok{\# Now arithmetic works}
\NormalTok{    result }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ mixed\_numeric }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{5}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"After adding 5:"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(result)}
\ControlFlowTok{except} \PreprocessorTok{Exception} \ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ e:}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"Error: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{e}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# 🔧 Issue 3: NaN and infinity handling}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{🔧 NaN and Infinity Handling:"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Create data with NaN and inf}
\NormalTok{test\_data }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.Series([}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{, }\VariableTok{None}\NormalTok{, }\BuiltInTok{float}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}inf\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{), }\BuiltInTok{float}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}{-}inf\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{), }\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{])}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"Original data with NaN and infinity:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(test\_data)}

\CommentTok{\# Fill NaN with specific values}
\NormalTok{filled\_data }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ test\_data.fillna(}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{After filling NaN with 0:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(filled\_data)}

\CommentTok{\# Replace infinity with finite values}
\NormalTok{clean\_data }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ filled\_data.replace([}\BuiltInTok{float}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}inf\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{), }\BuiltInTok{float}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}{-}inf\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)], [}\DecValTok{999999}\NormalTok{, }\OperatorTok{{-}}\DecValTok{999999}\NormalTok{])}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{After replacing infinity:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(clean\_data)}

\CommentTok{\# 🎯 Best practices summary}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{💡 Best Practices for Robust Arithmetic:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"1. Check data types before operations: df.dtypes"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"2. Handle NaN values: fillna(), dropna(), or errors=\textquotesingle{}coerce\textquotesingle{}"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"3. Check for infinity: df.replace([inf, {-}inf], value)"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"4. Use explicit methods for better control: add(), sub(), mul(), div()"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"5. Validate results: df.isna().sum(), df.isinf().sum() if hasattr(df, \textquotesingle{}isinf\textquotesingle{})"}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsection{Are Arithmetic Operations
Vectorized?}\label{are-arithmetic-operations-vectorized}

Yes --- arithmetic operations in pandas are \textbf{vectorized} because
they rely on NumPy under the hood.\\
This means operations are applied \textbf{element-wise} across entire
columns or DataFrames at once, instead of looping through rows in
Python.

✅ \textbf{Benefits of Vectorization:}\\
- Much faster than Python loops (implemented in optimized C code)\\
- Cleaner and more concise syntax\\
- Handles \textbf{automatic alignment} on indexes and columns

\section{Correlation Operations: Understanding Relationships Between
Variables}\label{correlation-operations-understanding-relationships-between-variables}

\subsection{What is Correlation?}\label{what-is-correlation}

\textbf{Correlation} measures the \textbf{strength and direction} of the
linear relationship between two numerical variables. In business and
data science, correlation analysis helps you:

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Discover patterns} in your data
\item
  \textbf{Identify relationships} between metrics\\
\item
  \textbf{Make predictions} based on variable relationships
\item
  \textbf{Generate insights} for decision-making
\end{itemize}

\textbf{Key Concepts:}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Correlation ≠ Causation}: High correlation doesn't mean one
  variable causes the other
\item
  \textbf{Range}: Correlation values range from -1 to +1
\item
  \textbf{Interpretation}: Closer to ±1 = stronger relationship, closer
  to 0 = weaker relationship
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Correlation Coefficient
Interpretation}\label{correlation-coefficient-interpretation}

increase → Demand \\
\end{longtable}

\subsection{Correlation Types}\label{correlation-types}

Pandas provides multiple correlation methods that you can specify with\\
\texttt{df.corr(method=...)}. By default, it uses \textbf{Pearson}, but
it's important to know the alternatives and when to use them:

\begin{longtable}[]{@{}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 6\tabcolsep) * \real{0.1308}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 6\tabcolsep) * \real{0.2710}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 6\tabcolsep) * \real{0.2804}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 6\tabcolsep) * \real{0.3178}}@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
\begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
\textbf{Method}
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
\textbf{Best For}
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
\textbf{Advantages}
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
\textbf{Limitations}
\end{minipage} \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
\bottomrule\noalign{}
\endlastfoot
\textbf{Pearson} & Linear relationships & Simple, standard,
interpretable & Very sensitive to outliers \\
\textbf{Spearman} & Monotonic (rank-based) relationships & Handles
non-linearity well & Loses information about magnitude \\
\textbf{Kendall} & Robust rank correlation & Highly resistant to
outliers & Slower, computationally intensive \\
\end{longtable}

\subsubsection{Decision Guide: Choosing the Right
Correlation}\label{decision-guide-choosing-the-right-correlation}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# Simple decision tree for correlation choice:}

\ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ data\_has\_outliers }\KeywordTok{or}\NormalTok{ is\_non\_linear\_monotonic:}
\NormalTok{    use\_method }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"spearman"}   \CommentTok{\# Rank{-}based, robust to outliers}
\ControlFlowTok{elif}\NormalTok{ small\_sample\_size }\KeywordTok{or}\NormalTok{ need\_extra\_robustness:}
\NormalTok{    use\_method }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"kendall"}    \CommentTok{\# Most robust, but slower}
\ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{    use\_method }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"pearson"}    \CommentTok{\# Standard choice for linear correlation}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\textbf{💡 Note for this chapter:} We will focus on Pearson correlation,
since it is the default in pandas and most commonly used in practice.

\subsection{Pandas Correlation
Methods}\label{pandas-correlation-methods}

Pandas offers several methods for calculating correlations:

\begin{longtable}[]{@{}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.2963}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.3333}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.3704}}@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
\begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Method
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Purpose
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Use Case
\end{minipage} \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
\bottomrule\noalign{}
\endlastfoot
\textbf{\texttt{df.corr()}} & Full correlation matrix & Explore all
relationships \\
\textbf{\texttt{df{[}\textquotesingle{}A\textquotesingle{}{]}.corr(df{[}\textquotesingle{}B\textquotesingle{}{]})}}

Compare with benchmark \\

💡 In this chapter, we'll focus on the \textbf{first two methods}
(\texttt{df.corr()} and pairwise \texttt{.corr()}), and \textbf{skip

    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Advertising\_Spend\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.normal(}\DecValTok{1000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{200}\NormalTok{, n\_samples),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Website\_Traffic\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.normal(}\DecValTok{5000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1000}\NormalTok{, n\_samples),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Customer\_Satisfaction\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.normal(}\FloatTok{4.0}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.5}\NormalTok{, n\_samples),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Product\_Price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.normal(}\DecValTok{50}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{, n\_samples)}
\NormalTok{\})}

\CommentTok{\# Add some realistic correlations}
\NormalTok{sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Sales\_Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (}
    \FloatTok{0.8} \OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Advertising\_Spend\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} 
    \FloatTok{0.3} \OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Website\_Traffic\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} 
    \DecValTok{200} \OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Customer\_Satisfaction\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} 
\NormalTok{    np.random.normal(}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{500}\NormalTok{, n\_samples)}
\NormalTok{)}

\NormalTok{sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Conversion\_Rate\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (}
    \FloatTok{0.02} \OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.01} \OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Customer\_Satisfaction\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{{-}} 
    \FloatTok{0.0002} \OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Product\_Price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}
\NormalTok{    np.random.normal(}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.005}\NormalTok{, n\_samples)}

\CommentTok{\# Ensure realistic ranges}
\NormalTok{sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Customer\_Satisfaction\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Customer\_Satisfaction\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].clip(}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Conversion\_Rate\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Conversion\_Rate\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].clip(}\FloatTok{0.001}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.1}\NormalTok{)}

\subsubsection{Method 1: Full Correlation
Matrix}\label{method-1-full-correlation-matrix}

The \textbf{correlation matrix} shows relationships between ALL
numerical variables at once:

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🔍 METHOD 1: FULL CORRELATION MATRIX}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"📊 CORRELATION MATRIX ANALYSIS"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{40}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Calculate correlation matrix using Pearson (default method)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🔢 PEARSON CORRELATION MATRIX"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{30}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{correlation\_matrix }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sales\_data.corr()  }\CommentTok{\# Pearson is default}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(correlation\_matrix.}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{))}

\CommentTok{\# Business interpretation}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{💼 BUSINESS INTERPRETATION:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{25}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Find strongest correlations}
\NormalTok{correlation\_pairs }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ []}
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i, col1 }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{enumerate}\NormalTok{(correlation\_matrix.columns):}
    \ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ j, col2 }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{enumerate}\NormalTok{(correlation\_matrix.columns):}
        \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ i }\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{ j:  }\CommentTok{\# Avoid duplicates and self{-}correlation}
\NormalTok{            corr\_val }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ correlation\_matrix.loc[col1, col2]}
\NormalTok{            correlation\_pairs.append((col1, col2, corr\_val))}

\CommentTok{\# Sort by absolute correlation strength}
\NormalTok{correlation\_pairs.sort(key}\OperatorTok{=}\KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ x: }\BuiltInTok{abs}\NormalTok{(x[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]), reverse}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{True}\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🎯 Top 3 Strongest Relationships:"}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i, (col1, col2, corr\_val) }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{enumerate}\NormalTok{(correlation\_pairs[:}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{]):}
\NormalTok{    strength }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"Strong"} \ControlFlowTok{if} \BuiltInTok{abs}\NormalTok{(corr\_val) }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \FloatTok{0.7} \ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{"Moderate"} \ControlFlowTok{if} \BuiltInTok{abs}\NormalTok{(corr\_val) }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \FloatTok{0.3} \ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{"Weak"}
\NormalTok{    direction }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"Positive"} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ corr\_val }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{0} \ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{"Negative"}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{i}\OperatorTok{+}\DecValTok{1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{. }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ ↔️ }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   Correlation: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{corr\_val}\SpecialCharTok{:.3f\}}\SpecialStringTok{ (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{strength}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{direction}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{)"}\NormalTok{)}
    
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ corr\_val }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   📈 As }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ increases, }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ tends to increase"}\NormalTok{)}
    \ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   📉 As }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ increases, }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ tends to decrease"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{()}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{Method 2: Pairwise
Correlation}\label{method-2-pairwise-correlation}

For analyzing \textbf{specific relationships} between two variables:

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\#  METHOD 2: PAIRWISE CORRELATION ANALYSIS}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🔍 PAIRWISE CORRELATION ANALYSIS"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{50}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Select two interesting columns for detailed analysis}
\NormalTok{col1, col2 }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Advertising\_Spend\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Sales\_Revenue\textquotesingle{}}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"🎬 Analyzing relationship between \textquotesingle{}}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{} and \textquotesingle{}}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{}"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{60}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Calculate Pearson correlation for the pair (default method)}
\NormalTok{correlation\_value }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[col1].corr(sales\_data[col2])}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"📊 Correlation coefficient: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{correlation\_value}\SpecialCharTok{:.4f\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Detailed interpretation}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{💡 INTERPRETATION:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{20}\NormalTok{)}

\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ interpret\_correlation(corr\_val):}
\NormalTok{    abs\_corr }\OperatorTok{=} \BuiltInTok{abs}\NormalTok{(corr\_val)}
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ abs\_corr }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \FloatTok{0.8}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{        strength }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"Very Strong"}
    \ControlFlowTok{elif}\NormalTok{ abs\_corr }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \FloatTok{0.6}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{        strength }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"Strong"}  
    \ControlFlowTok{elif}\NormalTok{ abs\_corr }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \FloatTok{0.3}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{        strength }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"Moderate"}
    \ControlFlowTok{elif}\NormalTok{ abs\_corr }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \FloatTok{0.1}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{        strength }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"Weak"}
    \ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{        strength }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"Very Weak/None"}
        
\NormalTok{    direction }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"Positive"} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ corr\_val }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{0} \ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{"Negative"}
    \ControlFlowTok{return} \SpecialStringTok{f"}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{strength}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{direction}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"🔢 Relationship strength: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{interpret\_correlation(correlation\_value)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Business context}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🎯 BUSINESS CONTEXT:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{20}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{if} \BuiltInTok{abs}\NormalTok{(correlation\_value) }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \FloatTok{0.5}\NormalTok{:}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"✅ Strong relationship detected!"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   • This suggests }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ and }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ move together"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"   • Could be useful for predictions or business decisions"}\NormalTok{)}
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ correlation\_value }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   • Higher }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ is associated with higher }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   • Higher }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ is associated with lower }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"⚠️  Moderate/Weak relationship detected"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   • }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ and }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ don\textquotesingle{}t have a strong linear relationship"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"   • Consider other factors or non{-}linear relationships"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Demonstrate different variable pairs}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🔍 OTHER INTERESTING PAIRS:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{25}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{pairs\_to\_check }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
\NormalTok{    (}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Customer\_Satisfaction\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Sales\_Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{),}
\NormalTok{    (}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Product\_Price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Conversion\_Rate\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{),}
\NormalTok{    (}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Website\_Traffic\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Sales\_Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{]}

\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ pair\_col1, pair\_col2 }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ pairs\_to\_check:}
\NormalTok{    pair\_corr }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sales\_data[pair\_col1].corr(sales\_data[pair\_col2])}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{pair\_col1}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ ↔️ }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{pair\_col2}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{pair\_corr}\SpecialCharTok{:.3f\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{Advanced Correlation Analysis: Finding Strong
Correlations
Programmatically}\label{advanced-correlation-analysis-finding-strong-correlations-programmatically}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🔍 ADVANCED CORRELATION ANALYSIS}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{" ADVANCED CORRELATION TECHNIQUES"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{50}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# 1. Find strongest correlations programmatically}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{" 1. FINDING STRONGEST CORRELATIONS"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{35}\NormalTok{)}

\NormalTok{correlation\_matrix }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sales\_data.corr()  }\CommentTok{\# Uses Pearson correlation by default}

\CommentTok{\# Create a function to find strong correlations}
\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ find\_strong\_correlations(corr\_matrix, threshold}\OperatorTok{=}\FloatTok{0.5}\NormalTok{):}
    \CommentTok{"""Find correlations above threshold, excluding diagonal"""}
\NormalTok{    strong\_corrs }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ []}
    
    \ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{range}\NormalTok{(}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(corr\_matrix.columns)):}
        \ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ j }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{range}\NormalTok{(i}\OperatorTok{+}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(corr\_matrix.columns)):  }\CommentTok{\# Avoid duplicates and diagonal}
\NormalTok{            col1 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ corr\_matrix.columns[i]}
\NormalTok{            col2 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ corr\_matrix.columns[j] }
\NormalTok{            corr\_val }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ corr\_matrix.iloc[i, j]}
            
            \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ pd.notna(corr\_val) }\KeywordTok{and} \BuiltInTok{abs}\NormalTok{(corr\_val) }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=}\NormalTok{ threshold:}
\NormalTok{                strong\_corrs.append(\{}
                    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Variable1\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: col1,}
                    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Variable2\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: col2,}
                    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Correlation\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: corr\_val,}
                    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Strength\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\BuiltInTok{abs}\NormalTok{(corr\_val)}
\NormalTok{                \})}
    
    \ControlFlowTok{return}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(strong\_corrs).sort\_values(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Strength\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, ascending}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{False}\NormalTok{)}

\NormalTok{strong\_correlations }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ find\_strong\_correlations(correlation\_matrix, threshold}\OperatorTok{=}\FloatTok{0.3}\NormalTok{)}

\ControlFlowTok{if} \BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(strong\_correlations) }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{:}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"📊 Found }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(strong\_correlations)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ correlations above 0.3 threshold:"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(strong\_correlations.}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{))}
    
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🎯 TOP CORRELATION:"}\NormalTok{)}
    \ControlFlowTok{if} \BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(strong\_correlations) }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{        top\_corr }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ strong\_correlations.iloc[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{top\_corr[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Variable1\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ ↔️ }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{top\_corr[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Variable2\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   Strength: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{top\_corr[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Correlation\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{:.3f\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
        
        \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ top\_corr[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Correlation\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{:}
            \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"   📈 Positive relationship: both increase/decrease together"}\NormalTok{)}
        \ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
            \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"   📉 Negative relationship: one increases as other decreases"}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"📊 No strong correlations found above 0.3 threshold"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"💡 Try lowering threshold or check data quality"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# 2. Correlation matrix summary}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🌡️ 2. CORRELATION MATRIX SUMMARY"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{30}\NormalTok{)}

\ControlFlowTok{if} \BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(correlation\_matrix) }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{:}
    \CommentTok{\# Summary statistics of correlations}
\NormalTok{    corr\_values }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ correlation\_matrix.values}
    \CommentTok{\# Get upper triangle (excluding diagonal)}
\NormalTok{    mask }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ np.triu(np.ones\_like(corr\_values, dtype}\OperatorTok{=}\BuiltInTok{bool}\NormalTok{), k}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ corr\_values[mask]}
    
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"📊 Matrix size: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{correlation\_matrix}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{shape[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ x }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{correlation\_matrix}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{shape[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"📈 Highest correlation: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{np}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{nanmax(upper\_triangle)}\SpecialCharTok{:.3f\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"📉 Lowest correlation: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{np}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{nanmin(upper\_triangle)}\SpecialCharTok{:.3f\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"📊 Average correlation: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{np}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{nanmean(upper\_triangle)}\SpecialCharTok{:.3f\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    
    \CommentTok{\# Count correlations by strength}
\NormalTok{    strong\_positive }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ np.}\BuiltInTok{sum}\NormalTok{(upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \FloatTok{0.5}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    strong\_negative }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ np.}\BuiltInTok{sum}\NormalTok{(upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.5}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    moderate }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ np.}\BuiltInTok{sum}\NormalTok{((upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \FloatTok{0.3}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{\&}\NormalTok{ (upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{\textless{}} \FloatTok{0.5}\NormalTok{)) }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ np.}\BuiltInTok{sum}\NormalTok{((upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.3}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{\&}\NormalTok{ (upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.5}\NormalTok{))}
\NormalTok{    weak }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ np.}\BuiltInTok{sum}\NormalTok{((upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.3}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{\&}\NormalTok{ (upper\_triangle }\OperatorTok{\textless{}} \FloatTok{0.3}\NormalTok{))}
    
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{📊 CORRELATION STRENGTH DISTRIBUTION:"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   🔥 Strong (|r| ≥ 0.5):    }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{strong\_positive }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ strong\_negative}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   📊 Moderate (0.3 ≤ |r| \textless{} 0.5): }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{moderate}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"   ⚪ Weak (|r| \textless{} 0.3):       }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{weak}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{💡 PRO TIPS FOR CORRELATION ANALYSIS:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{35}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"✅ Always visualize correlations with scatter plots"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"✅ Check for non{-}linear relationships"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"✅ Consider domain knowledge when interpreting"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"✅ Remember: correlation ≠ causation"}\NormalTok{)}

\subsection{Are Correlation Operations
Vectorized?}\label{are-correlation-operations-vectorized}

Yes! Correlation operations in pandas (and NumPy under the hood) are
\textbf{vectorized}:

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{No explicit loops:} Correlations are computed using optimized
  NumPy routines in C, avoiding slow Python row-by-row iteration.\\
\item
  \textbf{Matrix-based computation:} \texttt{df.corr()} computes the
  covariance matrix of all numeric columns at once, then scales it into
  a correlation matrix.\\
\item
  \textbf{Pairwise efficiency:} Even
  \texttt{df{[}\textquotesingle{}A\textquotesingle{}{]}.corr(df{[}\textquotesingle{}B\textquotesingle{}{]})}
  leverages array-level operations on entire columns, not
  element-by-element loops.\\
\item
  \textbf{Scalability:} Vectorization makes correlation fast and
  efficient for large datasets, with memory (not speed) usually being
  the main limitation.
\end{itemize}

💡 This is why pandas can compute full \emph{n × n} correlation matrices
quickly, even for wide datasets.

\section{Advanced Operations: Function Application \& Data
Transformation}\label{advanced-operations-function-application-data-transformation}

Pandas provides powerful methods for applying functions to DataFrame
rows, columns, or individual elements. These methods are the
\textbf{cornerstone of advanced data manipulation}, enabling complex
transformations that would be cumbersome with basic operations.

\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{apply()}: The Swiss Army Knife of
Data
Transformation}{apply(): The Swiss Army Knife of Data Transformation}}\label{apply-the-swiss-army-knife-of-data-transformation}

The \texttt{apply()} function is one of pandas' most versatile tools. It
can apply \textbf{any custom or built-in function} across DataFrame axes
or to elements in a Series, making it ideal for flexible
transformations.

\subsubsection{Core Concepts}\label{core-concepts}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Row-wise operations (\texttt{axis=1})} → apply a function
  across rows (each row passed as a Series)\\
\item
  \textbf{Column-wise operations (\texttt{axis=0})} → apply a function
  across columns (each column passed as a Series)\\
\item
  \textbf{Element-wise operations} → apply a function to each value in a
  Series
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{Syntax Patterns}\label{syntax-patterns}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# DataFrame apply() {-} row{-}wise or column{-}wise}
\NormalTok{df.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(function, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)        }\CommentTok{\# Row{-}wise (rows as Series)}
\NormalTok{df.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(function, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{)        }\CommentTok{\# Column{-}wise (columns as Series)}

\CommentTok{\# Series apply() {-} element{-}wise}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}column\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(function)      }\CommentTok{\# Each element passed individually}

\CommentTok{\# With additional arguments}
\NormalTok{df.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(function, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, args}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{(arg1, arg2))}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{Real-World Example: Financial
Analysis}\label{real-world-example-financial-analysis}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 📈 Create a comprehensive financial dataset}

\CommentTok{\# Generate realistic financial data}
\NormalTok{np.random.seed(}\DecValTok{42}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{n\_companies }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{100}

\NormalTok{financial\_data }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Company\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\SpecialStringTok{f\textquotesingle{}Company\_}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{i}\SpecialCharTok{:03d\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{range}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, n\_companies }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.normal(}\DecValTok{50000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{15000}\NormalTok{, n\_companies).}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Expenses\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.normal(}\DecValTok{35000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{10000}\NormalTok{, n\_companies).}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Employees\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.randint(}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{500}\NormalTok{, n\_companies),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Market\_Cap\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.lognormal(}\DecValTok{15}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, n\_companies).}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Industry\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Tech\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Healthcare\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Finance\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Retail\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Manufacturing\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], n\_companies),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Founded\_Year\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.randint(}\DecValTok{1990}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2020}\NormalTok{, n\_companies),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Country\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}USA\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Canada\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}UK\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Germany\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Japan\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], n\_companies)}
\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{df\_financial }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(financial\_data)}

\CommentTok{\# Ensure expenses don\textquotesingle{}t exceed revenue (business logic)}
\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ cap\_expenses(row):}
    \CommentTok{"""}
\CommentTok{    Ensure expenses don\textquotesingle{}t exceed 95\% of revenue}
\CommentTok{    This prevents companies from having expenses that are too close to or exceed their revenue}
\CommentTok{    """}
    \CommentTok{\# Calculate the maximum allowed expenses (95\% of revenue)}
\NormalTok{    max\_allowed\_expenses }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*} \FloatTok{0.95}
    
    \CommentTok{\# Return the smaller value: either current expenses or the maximum allowed}
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Expenses\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ max\_allowed\_expenses:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return}\NormalTok{ max\_allowed\_expenses}
    \ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Expenses\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}

\CommentTok{\# Apply the function to each row}
\NormalTok{df\_financial[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Expenses\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_financial.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(cap\_expenses, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Calculate profit and profit margin for each company}
\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ calculate\_profit(row):}
    \ControlFlowTok{return}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Expenses\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}

\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ calculate\_profit\_margin(row):}
\NormalTok{    profit }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Expenses\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
    \ControlFlowTok{return} \BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{((profit }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]) }\OperatorTok{*} \DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{) }\ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{0} \ControlFlowTok{else} \DecValTok{0}

\CommentTok{\# Apply functions to create new columns}
\NormalTok{df\_financial[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Profit\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_financial.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(calculate\_profit, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{df\_financial[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Profit\_Margin\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_financial.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(calculate\_profit\_margin, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)}


\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{Dataset shape: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{df\_financial}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{shape}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"Industries: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{df\_financial[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Industry\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{unique()}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"📊 Financial Dataset Sample:"}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{df\_financial.head(}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{How \texttt{apply()} Actually
Works}{How apply() Actually Works}}\label{how-apply-actually-works}

\texttt{apply()} is essentially a \textbf{Python-level loop} that
iterates over each \textbf{row} or \textbf{column} and applies your
function one-by-one.\\
It's \textbf{much slower} than true \textbf{vectorized} operations
(NumPy ufuncs, pandas built-ins).

\begin{quote}
✅ Prefer vectorized operations whenever possible.\\
🔁 Use \texttt{apply()} only when logic can't be expressed with
vectorized methods.
\end{quote}

\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{map()}: Efficient Element-wise
Transformations (on a
\textbf{Series})}{map(): Efficient Element-wise Transformations (on a Series)}}\label{map-efficient-element-wise-transformations-on-a-series}

\texttt{Series.map()} applies a transformation \textbf{element by
element} and is often faster/simpler than \texttt{apply()} for 1-to-1
lookups or simple functions.

\subsubsection{✅ When to use}\label{when-to-use}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Value mapping / recoding} (e.g., codes → labels)
\item
  \textbf{Category encoding} (labels → numbers)
\item
  \textbf{Simple per-value transforms} (string cleanup, parsing,
  normalization)
\item
  \textbf{Lookup from a codebook} stored as a dict or another Series
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{Three Ways to Use
\texttt{map()}}{Three Ways to Use map()}}\label{three-ways-to-use-map}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# Sample data}
\NormalTok{df }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(\{}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Industry\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Tech\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Healthcare\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Finance\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Tech\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Retail\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Size\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Small\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Large\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Medium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Small\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Large\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\DecValTok{100000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{150000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{80000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{120000}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{90000}\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{\})}

\CommentTok{\# 1. **Dictionary Mapping** {-} Most Common}
\NormalTok{industry\_codes }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Tech\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Healthcare\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Finance\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Retail\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{\}}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Industry\_Code\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Industry\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{map}\NormalTok{(industry\_codes)}

\CommentTok{\# 2. **Function Mapping**}
\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ add\_prefix(industry):}
    \ControlFlowTok{return} \SpecialStringTok{f"IND\_}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{industry}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}

\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Industry\_Prefixed\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Industry\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{map}\NormalTok{(add\_prefix)}

\CommentTok{\# 3. **Series Mapping**}
\NormalTok{size\_priority }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.Series(\{}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Small\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Medium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Large\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{\})}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Size\_Priority\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Size\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{map}\NormalTok{(size\_priority)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(df)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{How \texttt{map()} Actually
Works:}{How map() Actually Works:}}\label{how-map-actually-works}

\texttt{map()} iterates through each element in the Series and applies
the mapping function/dictionary lookup individually.

\begin{Shaded}

\CommentTok{\# 🚀 Practical Performance Comparison: Real{-}World Examples}

\CommentTok{\# Create a realistic dataset for performance testing}
\NormalTok{np.random.seed(}\DecValTok{42}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{n\_rows }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{50000}

    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_id\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\BuiltInTok{range}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, n\_rows }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.uniform(}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1000}\NormalTok{, n\_rows),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_pct\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{15}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{20}\NormalTok{], n\_rows),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}category\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}A\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}B\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}C\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}D\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], n\_rows),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.randint(}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{6}\NormalTok{, n\_rows),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}is\_premium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\VariableTok{True}\NormalTok{, }\VariableTok{False}\NormalTok{], n\_rows)}
\NormalTok{\})}

\CommentTok{\# 📊 Test 1: Simple Mathematical Operations}

\CommentTok{\# Method 1: VECTORIZED (Fastest)}

\NormalTok{performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}final\_price\_vectorized\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ (}\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_pct\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{vectorized\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\CommentTok{\# Method 2: APPLY with function (Slower)}
\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ calculate\_final\_price(row):}
    \ControlFlowTok{return}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ (}\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_pct\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{)}

\NormalTok{start\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time()}
\NormalTok{performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}final\_price\_apply\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ performance\_data.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(calculate\_final\_price, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{apply\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"✅ Vectorized:    }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{vectorized\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.4f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (1.0x baseline)"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"⚙️  Apply function: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{apply\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.4f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{apply\_time}\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{vectorized\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{x slower)"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Verify results are identical}
\NormalTok{results\_match }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}final\_price\_vectorized\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{ performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}final\_price\_apply\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{)).}\BuiltInTok{all}\NormalTok{()}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"🔍 Results identical: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{results\_match}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\NormalTok{replace\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"🔄 Apply():      }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{apply\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.4f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{apply\_time}\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{map\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{x slower)"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"🔄 Replace():    }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{replace\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.4f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{replace\_time}\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{map\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{x slower)"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Clean up test columns}
\NormalTok{performance\_data.drop([}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}category\_name\_apply\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}category\_name\_replace\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, inplace}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{True}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 📊 Test 3: Complex Business Logic (When apply() is necessary)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{💼 Test 3: Complex business rules (multi{-}column conditional logic)"}\NormalTok{)}

\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ customer\_segment\_complex(row):}
    \CommentTok{"""Complex business logic that requires apply()"""}
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}is\_premium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\KeywordTok{and}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{500}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}VIP\textquotesingle{}}
    \ControlFlowTok{elif}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}is\_premium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\KeywordTok{and}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Premium+\textquotesingle{}}  
    \ControlFlowTok{elif}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{200} \KeywordTok{and}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}High Value\textquotesingle{}}
    \ControlFlowTok{elif}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Standard\textquotesingle{}}
    \ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Basic\textquotesingle{}}

\CommentTok{\# Method 1: APPLY (Necessary for complex logic)}
\NormalTok{start\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time()}
\NormalTok{performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}segment\_apply\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ performance\_data.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(customer\_segment\_complex, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{apply\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\CommentTok{\# Method 2: VECTORIZED with np.where (More complex but faster)}
\NormalTok{start\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time()}
\NormalTok{conditions }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
\NormalTok{    (performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}is\_premium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\&}\NormalTok{ (performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{500}\NormalTok{)),}
\NormalTok{    (performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}is\_premium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\&}\NormalTok{ (performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{)),}
\NormalTok{    ((performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{200}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{\&}\NormalTok{ (performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{)),}
\NormalTok{    (performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{choices }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}VIP\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Premium+\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}High Value\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Standard\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}segment\_vectorized\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ np.select(conditions, choices, default}\OperatorTok{=}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Basic\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{vectorized\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"🔄 Apply():      }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{apply\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.4f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (1.0x baseline)"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"✅ Vectorized:  }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{vectorized\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.4f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{apply\_time}\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{vectorized\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{x faster!)"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Verify results match}
\NormalTok{results\_match }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}segment\_apply\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{ performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}segment\_vectorized\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]).}\BuiltInTok{all}\NormalTok{()}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"🔍 Results identical: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{results\_match}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Show distribution}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{📈 Customer Segment Distribution:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(performance\_data[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}segment\_apply\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].value\_counts().to\_dict())}

\CommentTok{\# Clean up}
\NormalTok{performance\_data.drop([}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}segment\_vectorized\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, inplace}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{True}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\begin{verbatim}

💼 Test 3: Complex business rules (multi-column conditional logic)
🔄 Apply():      0.3600s (1.0x baseline)
✅ Vectorized:  0.0005s (684.8x faster!)
🔍 Results identical: True

📈 Customer Segment Distribution:
{'Standard': 20606, 'VIP': 12663, 'High Value': 8116, 'Premium+': 4967, 'Basic': 3648}
\end{verbatim}

\textbf{Key Takeaway}

\begin{itemize}
\item
  \texttt{apply()} and \texttt{map()} are \textbf{not vectorized} ---
  under the hood they behave like Python loops.\\
  Pandas iterates through each row or column and calls your function,
  which can be slow on large datasets.
\item
  For \textbf{value substitutions}, use \texttt{pandas.replace()} ---
  it's \textbf{vectorized} and far faster than writing an
  \texttt{apply()} with a custom function.
\item
  By contrast, \textbf{arithmetic operations inside a DataFrame} are
  backed by optimized \textbf{NumPy routines}, making them highly
  efficient and scalable.
\end{itemize}

\section{Why Vectorization Matters: The NumPy
Foundation}\label{why-vectorization-matters-the-numpy-foundation}

\subsection{The Secret Behind Pandas
Speed}\label{the-secret-behind-pandas-speed}

Pandas is \textbf{built on top of NumPy}, which means that
\textbf{vectorized operations} are actually \textbf{compiled C code}
running under the hood. This is why vectorized operations can be
\textbf{10-100x faster} than Python loops!

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\#  Python Loop (Slow)}
\NormalTok{result }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ []}
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{range}\NormalTok{(}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(df)):}
\NormalTok{    result.append(df.iloc[i][}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}col1\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ df.iloc[i][}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}col2\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{])}

\CommentTok{\#  Vectorized Operation (Fast {-} uses NumPy\textquotesingle{}s C code)}
\NormalTok{result }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}col1\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}col2\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsection{What Happens Under the
Hood}\label{what-happens-under-the-hood}

\begin{longtable}[]{@{}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.2162}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.5946}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.1892}}@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
\begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Method
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
What Actually Happens
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Speed
\end{minipage} \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
\bottomrule\noalign{}
\endlastfoot
\textbf{Vectorized} & NumPy C code processes entire arrays & 🚀
\textbf{10-100x faster} \\
\textbf{apply()} & Python function called once per row/column & 🔄
\textbf{5-20x slower} \\
\textbf{map()} & Python function called once per element & 🔄
\textbf{2-10x slower} \\
\end{longtable}

\subsection{The NumPy Advantage}\label{the-numpy-advantage}

\subsubsection{Memory Efficiency}\label{memory-efficiency}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Contiguous memory}: All data stored together in memory
\item
  \textbf{Type homogeneity}: All elements are the same data type\\
\item
  \textbf{No Python object overhead}: Direct C data structures
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{Parallel Processing}\label{parallel-processing}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{SIMD operations}: Single Instruction, Multiple Data
\item
  \textbf{Optimized algorithms}: Decades of mathematical optimization
\item
  \textbf{Hardware acceleration}: Leverages CPU vector instructions
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{Broadcasting Magic}\label{broadcasting-magic}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# This works efficiently across different shapes}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}normalized\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}values\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}values\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].mean()) }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}values\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].std()}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🎯 Practical Vectorization Examples: From Slow to Fast}

\CommentTok{\# Sample data for vectorization demonstration}
\NormalTok{sample\_df }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(\{}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{200}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{150}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{80}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{300}\NormalTok{],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{],  }
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}tax\_rate\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\FloatTok{0.08}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.08}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.08}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.08}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.08}\NormalTok{],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\FloatTok{0.1}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.0}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.15}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.05}\NormalTok{, }\FloatTok{0.2}\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{\})}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🎯 Vectorization Examples:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"Original Data:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(sample\_df)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{"} \OperatorTok{+} \StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{60}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🐌 SLOW WAY (Don\textquotesingle{}t do this!):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"for i in range(len(df)): result.append(df.iloc[i][\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}] * df.iloc[i][\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}])"}\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{✅ FAST WAY (Vectorized):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"df[\textquotesingle{}total\textquotesingle{}] = df[\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}] * df[\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}]"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Demonstrate vectorized operations}
\NormalTok{sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}subtotal\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}subtotal\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]  }
\NormalTok{sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}after\_discount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}subtotal\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}tax\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}after\_discount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}tax\_rate\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}final\_total\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}after\_discount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ sample\_df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}tax\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{📊 Results (all calculated with vectorized operations):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(sample\_df[[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}subtotal\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}final\_total\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]].}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{))}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}
