\subsection{Advanced Decision Framework: The Complete
Guide}\label{advanced-decision-framework-the-complete-guide}

\subsubsection{Always Try Vectorized
First}\label{always-try-vectorized-first}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# ✅ GOOD: Look for vectorized operations first}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}profit\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}expenses\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]  }\CommentTok{\# Vector arithmetic}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}high\_profit\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}profit\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{10000}       \CommentTok{\# Vector comparison  }
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}log\_revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ np.log(df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}revenue\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{])      }\CommentTok{\# NumPy universal functions}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}clean\_name\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}name\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{str}\NormalTok{.upper()     }\CommentTok{\# Built{-}in string vectorization}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{Use map() for Simple 1:1
Mappings}\label{use-map-for-simple-11-mappings}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# ✅ PERFECT for map(): Dictionary lookups}
\NormalTok{status\_map }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}A\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Active\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}I\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Inactive\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}P\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Pending\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{\}}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}status\_desc\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}status\_code\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{map}\NormalTok{(status\_map)}

\CommentTok{\# ✅ PERFECT for map(): Simple transformations  }
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\_category\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{map}\NormalTok{(}\KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ x: }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}High\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ x }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{100} \ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Low\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{Use apply() When Vectorization Isn't
Possible}\label{use-apply-when-vectorization-isnt-possible}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# ✅ GOOD use of apply(): Complex multi{-}column logic}
\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ complex\_business\_rule(row):}
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}premium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\KeywordTok{and}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}amount\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{1000} \KeywordTok{and}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}VIP\textquotesingle{}}
    \ControlFlowTok{elif}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}premium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\KeywordTok{and}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}loyalty\_years\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Gold\textquotesingle{}}
    \ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{:}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Standard\textquotesingle{}}

\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}tier\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(complex\_business\_rule, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{❌ What to Avoid}\label{what-to-avoid}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# ❌ DON\textquotesingle{}T: Use iterrows() }
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ idx, row }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ df.iterrows():  }\CommentTok{\# 50{-}200x slower!}
    \CommentTok{\# ... do something}
    
\CommentTok{\# ❌ DON\textquotesingle{}T: Use apply() when vectorized options exist}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}\KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ row: row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}qty\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)  }\CommentTok{\# Slow!}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}qty\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]  }\CommentTok{\# Fast!}

\CommentTok{\# ❌ DON\textquotesingle{}T: Use apply() for simple mappings}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}category\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}code\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}\KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ x: mapping\_dict[x])  }\CommentTok{\# Unnecessary!}
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}category\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}code\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{map}\NormalTok{(mapping\_dict)  }\CommentTok{\# Better!}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\section{Summary: Performance-First
Mindset}\label{summary-performance-first-mindset}

\subsection{Key Takeaways}\label{key-takeaways}

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\arabic{enumi}.}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Vectorization is King}: Always your first choice - leverages
  NumPy's C-speed processing
\item
  \textbf{map() for Mappings}: Perfect for dictionaries and simple
  element-wise transformations\\
\item
  \textbf{apply() for Complex Logic}: Use when business rules require
  multiple columns or complex conditions
\item
  \textbf{Avoid Python Loops}: iterrows(), list comprehensions are
  performance killers
\end{enumerate}

\subsection{Looking Ahead: Why NumPy
Matters}\label{looking-ahead-why-numpy-matters}

The next chapter will dive deep into \textbf{NumPy}, the foundation that
makes pandas so powerful. You'll learn:

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Array Architecture}: How NumPy's C-based arrays enable
  lightning-fast operations
\item
  \textbf{Broadcasting Rules}: Advanced techniques for working with
  different array shapes\\
\item
  \textbf{Universal Functions (ufuncs)}: The secret weapons behind
  vectorized operations
\item
  \textbf{Custom Vectorization}: How to write your own fast,
  NumPy-powered functions
\end{itemize}

\subsection{The Performance Pyramid}\label{the-performance-pyramid}

\begin{verbatim}
🚀 NumPy Vectorized (Next Chapter!)
    ↑ 10-100x faster
⚡ Pandas Vectorized  
    ↑ 2-5x faster
🔄 map() / apply()
    ↑ 50-200x faster  
🐌 Python Loops (iterrows, comprehensions)
\end{verbatim}

\textbf{Understanding NumPy} will unlock the full potential of pandas
and give you the tools to write \textbf{production-ready,
high-performance} data analysis code!

\section{Lambda Functions: Inline Power for Data
Transformation}\label{lambda-functions-inline-power-for-data-transformation}

In the previous sections, we saw how to define a function and then use
\texttt{map()} or \texttt{apply()} to apply it.\\
With \textbf{lambda functions}, you can skip the definition step and
write the function \textbf{inline}.

Lambda functions are \textbf{anonymous, one-line functions} that provide
a concise way to express simple operations without creating a separate
\texttt{def} block.\\
They're the \textbf{Swiss Army knife} of pandas transformations ---
compact, versatile, and perfect for quick, one-off operations.

\subsection{Syntax \& Structure}\label{syntax-structure}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ arguments: expression}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsection{Key Characteristics}\label{key-characteristics}

\begin{longtable}[]{@{}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.2903}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.4194}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\linewidth - 4\tabcolsep) * \real{0.2903}}@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
\begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Feature
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Description
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Example
\end{minipage} \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
\bottomrule\noalign{}
\endlastfoot
\textbf{Anonymous} & No function name required &
\texttt{lambda\ x:\ x\ *\ 2} \\
\textbf{Single Expression} & Only one expression allowed &
\texttt{lambda\ x,\ y:\ x\ +\ y} \\
\textbf{Inline Definition} & Defined at point of use &
\texttt{df.apply(lambda\ row:\ row.sum(),\ axis=1)} \\
\textbf{Return Value} & Automatically returns expression result &
\texttt{lambda\ x:\ x\ **\ 2} returns squared value \\
\textbf{Multiple Arguments} & Can accept multiple parameters &
\texttt{lambda\ x,\ y,\ z:\ x\ *\ y\ +\ z} \\
\end{longtable}

\subsection{Real-World Lambda
Applications}\label{real-world-lambda-applications}

In this section, we'll explore \textbf{practical use cases of lambda
functions} in pandas and demonstrate common transformation patterns.

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🎯 Create a comprehensive e{-}commerce dataset for lambda demonstrations}

\ImportTok{from}\NormalTok{ datetime }\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ datetime, timedelta}

    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}transaction\_id\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\SpecialStringTok{f\textquotesingle{}TXN\_}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{i}\SpecialCharTok{:05d\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{range}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, n\_transactions }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_id\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.randint(}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{200}\NormalTok{, n\_transactions),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}product\_name\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Laptop\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Smartphone\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Tablet\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Headphones\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Camera\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Watch\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Speaker\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Monitor\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Keyboard\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Mouse\textquotesingle{}}
\NormalTok{    ], n\_transactions),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.uniform(}\DecValTok{50}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2000}\NormalTok{, n\_transactions).}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.randint(}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{, n\_transactions),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_pct\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{15}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{20}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{25}\NormalTok{], n\_transactions),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}shipping\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.uniform(}\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{50}\NormalTok{, n\_transactions).}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{], n\_transactions),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}purchase\_date\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: pd.date\_range(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}2024{-}01{-}01\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, periods}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{n\_transactions, freq}\OperatorTok{=}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}h\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_type\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Premium\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Regular\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}New\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], n\_transactions),}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}payment\_method\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: np.random.choice([}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Credit Card\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}PayPal\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Bank Transfer\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], n\_transactions)}
\NormalTok{\}}

\subsubsection{Simple Mathematical
Operations}\label{simple-mathematical-operations}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 📊 Example 1: Simple Mathematical Operations with Lambda}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"=== SIMPLE MATHEMATICAL OPERATIONS ==="}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Calculate discounted price}
\NormalTok{df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discounted\_price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_ecommerce.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}
    \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ row: row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ (}\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_pct\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{), axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}
\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Calculate total cost (price + shipping)}
\NormalTok{df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_ecommerce.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}
    \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ row: row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discounted\_price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}shipping\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}
\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Calculate savings amount}
\NormalTok{df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}savings\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_ecommerce.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}
    \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ row: (row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discounted\_price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]) }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}
\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"💰 Price Calculations (First 10 transactions):"}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{price\_cols }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}transaction\_id\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discount\_pct\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}discounted\_price\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}savings\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(df\_ecommerce[price\_cols].head(}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{).to\_string(index}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{False}\NormalTok{))}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{Conditional Logic}\label{conditional-logic}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\NormalTok{df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}category\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}score\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}\KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ x: }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}High\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ x }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{80} \ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Low\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 📊 Example 2: Conditional Logic with Lambda}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{=== CONDITIONAL LOGIC OPERATIONS ==="}\NormalTok{)}

\NormalTok{)}

\NormalTok{)}

\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🚀 Example 4: Performance Optimization \& Advanced Lambda Patterns}

\CommentTok{\# Complex feature engineering}
\NormalTok{df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}value\_score\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_ecommerce.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}
    \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ row: (}
\NormalTok{        (row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{*} \FloatTok{0.4} \OperatorTok{+}  \CommentTok{\# 40\% weight on spending}
\NormalTok{        (row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{*} \FloatTok{0.3} \OperatorTok{+}  \CommentTok{\# 30\% weight on satisfaction  }
\NormalTok{        (}\DecValTok{1} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_type\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{==} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Premium\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{else} \FloatTok{0.5} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_type\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{==} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Regular\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{else} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{*} \FloatTok{0.2} \OperatorTok{+}  \CommentTok{\# 20\% weight on loyalty}
\NormalTok{        (}\BuiltInTok{min}\NormalTok{(row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}quantity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{], }\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{*} \FloatTok{0.1}  \CommentTok{\# 10\% weight on quantity (capped at 3)}
\NormalTok{    ), axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}
\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Risk assessment using multiple factors}
\NormalTok{df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}risk\_flag\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_ecommerce.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}
    \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ row: }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}High Risk\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ (}
\NormalTok{        row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{1000} \KeywordTok{and} 
\NormalTok{        row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}payment\_method\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{==} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Bank Transfer\textquotesingle{}} \KeywordTok{and} 
\NormalTok{        row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \DecValTok{2}
\NormalTok{    ) }\ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Medium Risk\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ (}
\NormalTok{        row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{500} \KeywordTok{or} 
\NormalTok{        row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_rating\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \DecValTok{2}
\NormalTok{    ) }\ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Low Risk\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, axis}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{1}
\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Calculate percentile ranking}
\NormalTok{total\_cost\_90th }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].quantile(}\FloatTok{0.9}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}is\_top\_spender\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}
    \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ cost: cost }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=}\NormalTok{ total\_cost\_90th}
\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🎯 Advanced Analytics Results:"}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{advanced\_cols }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}customer\_id\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}total\_cost\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}value\_score\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}risk\_flag\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}is\_top\_spender\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(df\_ecommerce[advanced\_cols].head(}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{).}\BuiltInTok{round}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{).to\_string(index}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{False}\NormalTok{))}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• Top spenders (90th percentile): }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{df\_ecommerce[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}is\_top\_spender\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{.}\BuiltInTok{sum}\NormalTok{()}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• Top spender threshold: $}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{total\_cost\_90th}\SpecialCharTok{:.2f\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\subsection{Performance Benchmarking: Lambda vs Named Functions vs
Vectorized}\label{performance-benchmarking-lambda-vs-named-functions-vs-vectorized}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🏁 Performance Benchmarking: Lambda vs Named Functions vs Vectorized}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ pandas }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ pd}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ numpy }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ np}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ time}

\CommentTok{\# Create LARGER test data to get measurable times}
\NormalTok{test\_data }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.Series(np.random.randint(}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{100}\NormalTok{, }\DecValTok{1000000}\NormalTok{))  }\CommentTok{\# 1M elements instead of 100K}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"⚡ Performance Comparison (1,000,000 operations):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"{-}"} \OperatorTok{*} \DecValTok{50}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Method 1: Lambda function}
\NormalTok{start\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time()}
\NormalTok{result\_lambda }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ test\_data.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(}\KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ x: x }\OperatorTok{**} \DecValTok{2} \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{lambda\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\CommentTok{\# Method 2: Named function}
\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ square\_plus\_ten(x):}
    \ControlFlowTok{return}\NormalTok{ x }\OperatorTok{**} \DecValTok{2} \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{10}

\NormalTok{start\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time()}
\NormalTok{result\_named }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ test\_data.}\BuiltInTok{apply}\NormalTok{(square\_plus\_ten)}
\NormalTok{named\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\CommentTok{\# Method 3: Vectorized operations (fastest)}
\NormalTok{start\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time()}
\NormalTok{result\_vectorized }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ test\_data }\OperatorTok{**} \DecValTok{2} \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{10}
\NormalTok{vectorized\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\CommentTok{\# Method 4: List comprehension}
\NormalTok{start\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time()}
\NormalTok{result\_listcomp }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.Series([x }\OperatorTok{**} \DecValTok{2} \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{10} \ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ x }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ test\_data])}
\NormalTok{listcomp\_time }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ time.time() }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ start\_time}

\CommentTok{\# Safe comparison {-} avoid division by zero}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"Vectorized operations: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{vectorized\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.6f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (baseline)"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"Lambda function:       }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{lambda\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.6f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{lambda\_time}\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{vectorized\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{x slower)"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"Named function:        }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{named\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.6f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{named\_time}\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{vectorized\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{x slower)"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"List comprehension:    }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{listcomp\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.6f\}}\SpecialStringTok{s (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{listcomp\_time}\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{vectorized\_time}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{x slower)"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Verify results are identical}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{✅ Results identical: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{result\_lambda}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{equals(result\_named) }\KeywordTok{and}\NormalTok{ result\_named}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{equals(result\_vectorized)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{💡 Performance Insights:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"• Vectorized operations are fastest for simple math"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"• Named functions have slight overhead advantage over lambdas"}\NormalTok{)  }
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"• Lambda functions are good compromise between speed and readability"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"• List comprehensions are generally slower than pandas methods"}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\begin{verbatim}
⚡ Performance Comparison (1,000,000 operations):
--------------------------------------------------
Vectorized operations: 0.002011s (baseline)
Lambda function:       0.263592s (131.1x slower)
Named function:        0.280185s (139.3x slower)
List comprehension:    0.251086s (124.9x slower)

✅ Results identical: False

💡 Performance Insights:
• Vectorized operations are fastest for simple math
• Named functions have slight overhead advantage over lambdas
• Lambda functions are good compromise between speed and readability
• List comprehensions are generally slower than pandas methods
\end{verbatim}

&

\subsubsection{Lambda Decision
Framework}\label{lambda-decision-framework}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# Use Lambda when:}
\NormalTok{simple\_operation }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ x: x }\OperatorTok{*} \DecValTok{2}           \CommentTok{\# ✅ Simple math}
\NormalTok{conditional }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ x: }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}A\textquotesingle{}} \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ x }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{5} \ControlFlowTok{else} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}B\textquotesingle{}}  \CommentTok{\# ✅ Basic conditions  }
\NormalTok{string\_ops }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{lambda}\NormalTok{ s: s.upper()            }\CommentTok{\# ✅ Simple string ops}

\CommentTok{\# Avoid Lambda when:}
\CommentTok{\# ❌ Complex logic (use named functions)}
\CommentTok{\# ❌ Multiple steps (break into separate operations)  }
\CommentTok{\# ❌ Reusable logic (define proper functions)}
\CommentTok{\# ❌ Available vectorized operations}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\section{Advanced NLP Preprocessing}\label{advanced-nlp-preprocessing}

For text data stored in \textbf{object (string) columns}, pandas works
seamlessly with Python's built-in string functions.\\
Beyond that, you can also use the \textbf{\texttt{re} (regular
expressions)} module and the \textbf{NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit)}
library for more advanced text preprocessing.

These tools are not commonly needed for this sequence course, but they
are powerful for tasks such as text cleaning, tokenization, and feature
extraction --- especially if you choose an NLP-focused topic for your
\textbf{final project}.

Below, we'll demonstrate how to use the \texttt{re} module and NLTK with
pandas columns.

\subsection{\texorpdfstring{the \texttt{re} module in Python is used for
regular
expression}{the re module in Python is used for regular expression}}\label{the-re-module-in-python-is-used-for-regular-expression}

The \texttt{re} module in Python is used for \textbf{regular
expressions}, which are powerful tools for text analysis and
manipulation. Regular expressions allow you to search, match, and
manipulate strings based on specific patterns.

Common Use Cases of \texttt{re} in String Text Analysis

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  Finding patterns in text:
  \texttt{re.search(r\textquotesingle{}\textbackslash{}d\{4\}-\textbackslash{}d\{2\}-\textbackslash{}d\{2\}\textquotesingle{},\ text)}
  \# searches for a date in the format YYYY-MM-DD
\item
  Extracting Specific parts of a string:
  \texttt{re.findall(r\textquotesingle{}\textbackslash{}b{[}A-Za-z0-9.\_\%+-{]}+@{[}A-Za-z0-9.-{]}+\textbackslash{}.{[}A-Z\textbar{}a-z{]}\{2,\}\textbackslash{}b\textquotesingle{},\ text)}
  \#extracts email addresses from the text.
\item
  Replacing Parts of a String:
  \texttt{re.sub(r\textquotesingle{}\textbackslash{}\$\textbackslash{}d+\textquotesingle{},\ \textquotesingle{}{[}price{]}\textquotesingle{},\ text)}
  \#replacing any price formatted as \$ with {[}price{]}.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{\texorpdfstring{Commonly Used Patterns in
\texttt{re}}{Commonly Used Patterns in re}}\label{commonly-used-patterns-in-re}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{\textbackslash{}d}}: Matches any digit (0-9).
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{\textbackslash{}w}}: Matches any alphanumeric
  character (letters and numbers).
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{\textbackslash{}s}}: Matches any whitespace character
  (spaces, tabs, newlines).
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{{[}a-z{]}}}: Matches any lowercase letter from
  \texttt{a} to \texttt{z}.
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{{[}A-Z{]}}}: Matches any uppercase letter from
  \texttt{A} to \texttt{Z}.
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{*}}: Matches 0 or more occurrences of the preceding
  character.
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{+}}: Matches 1 or more occurrences of the preceding
  character.
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{?}}: Matches 0 or 1 occurrence of the preceding
  character.
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{\^{}}}: Matches the beginning of a string.
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{\$}}: Matches the end of a string.
\item
  \textbf{\texttt{\textbar{}}}: Acts as an OR operator.
\end{itemize}

\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ requests}

\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ read\_html\_tables\_from\_url(url, match}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{None}\NormalTok{, user\_agent}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{None}\NormalTok{, timeout}\OperatorTok{=}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{, }\OperatorTok{**}\NormalTok{kwargs):}
    \CommentTok{"""}
\CommentTok{    Read HTML tables from a website URL with error handling and customizable options.}
\CommentTok{    }
\CommentTok{    Parameters:}
\CommentTok{    {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}}
\CommentTok{    url : str}
\CommentTok{        The website URL to scrape tables from}
\CommentTok{    match : str, optional}
\CommentTok{        String or regex pattern to match tables (passed to pd.read\_html)}
\CommentTok{    user\_agent : str, optional}
\CommentTok{        Custom User{-}Agent header. If None, uses a default Chrome User{-}Agent}
\CommentTok{    timeout : int, default 10}
\CommentTok{        Request timeout in seconds}
\CommentTok{    **kwargs : dict}
\CommentTok{        Additional arguments passed to pd.read\_html()}
\CommentTok{    }
\CommentTok{    Returns:}
\CommentTok{    {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}}
\CommentTok{    list of DataFrames or None}
\CommentTok{        List of pandas DataFrames (one per table found), or None if error occurs}
\CommentTok{    }
\CommentTok{    Examples:}
\CommentTok{    {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}}
\CommentTok{    \# Basic usage}
\CommentTok{    tables = read\_html\_tables\_from\_url("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List\_of\_countries\_by\_GDP\_(nominal)\_per\_capita")}
\CommentTok{    }
\CommentTok{    \# Filter tables containing specific text}
\CommentTok{    tables = read\_html\_tables\_from\_url(url, match="Country")}
\CommentTok{    }
\CommentTok{    \# With custom user agent}
\CommentTok{    tables = read\_html\_tables\_from\_url(url, user\_agent="MyBot/1.0")}
\CommentTok{    """}
    \ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ pandas }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ pd}
    \ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ requests}
    
    \CommentTok{\# Default User{-}Agent if none provided}
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ user\_agent }\KeywordTok{is} \VariableTok{None}\NormalTok{:}
\NormalTok{        user\_agent }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36\textquotesingle{}}
    
\NormalTok{    headers }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}User{-}Agent\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: user\_agent\}}
    
    \ControlFlowTok{try}\NormalTok{:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"🌐 Fetching data from: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{url}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
        
        \CommentTok{\# Make the HTTP request}
\NormalTok{        response }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ requests.get(url, headers}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{headers, timeout}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{timeout)}
\NormalTok{        response.raise\_for\_status()  }\CommentTok{\# Raise an exception for bad status codes (4xx or 5xx)}
        
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"✅ Successfully retrieved webpage (Status: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{response}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{status\_code}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{)"}\NormalTok{)}
        
        \CommentTok{\# Parse HTML tables}
\NormalTok{        read\_html\_kwargs }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}match\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: match\} }\ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ match }\ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{ \{\}}
\NormalTok{        read\_html\_kwargs.update(kwargs)  }\CommentTok{\# Add any additional arguments}
        
\NormalTok{        tables }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.read\_html(response.content, }\OperatorTok{**}\NormalTok{read\_html\_kwargs)}
        
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"📊 Found }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(tables)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ table(s) on the page"}\NormalTok{)}
        
        \CommentTok{\# Display table information}
        \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ tables:}
            \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{📋 Table Overview:"}\NormalTok{)}
            \ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i, table }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{enumerate}\NormalTok{(tables):}
                \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"  Table }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{i}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{table}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{shape}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ (rows × columns)"}\NormalTok{)}
                \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ i }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{:  }\CommentTok{\# Limit output for readability}
                    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"  ... and }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(tables) }\OperatorTok{{-}} \DecValTok{5}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ more tables"}\NormalTok{)}
                    \ControlFlowTok{break}
        
        \ControlFlowTok{return}\NormalTok{ tables}
        
    \ControlFlowTok{except}\NormalTok{ requests.exceptions.HTTPError }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ err:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"❌ HTTP Error: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{err}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \VariableTok{None}
    \ControlFlowTok{except}\NormalTok{ requests.exceptions.}\PreprocessorTok{ConnectionError} \ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ err:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"❌ Connection Error: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{err}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \VariableTok{None}
    \ControlFlowTok{except}\NormalTok{ requests.exceptions.Timeout }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ err:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"❌ Timeout Error: Request took longer than }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{timeout}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ seconds"}\NormalTok{)}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \VariableTok{None}
    \ControlFlowTok{except}\NormalTok{ requests.exceptions.RequestException }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ err:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"❌ Request Error: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{err}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \VariableTok{None}
    \ControlFlowTok{except} \PreprocessorTok{ValueError} \ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ err:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"❌ No tables found on the page or parsing error: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{err}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \VariableTok{None}
    \ControlFlowTok{except} \PreprocessorTok{Exception} \ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ e:}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"❌ An unexpected error occurred: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{e}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
        \ControlFlowTok{return} \VariableTok{None}

\subsection{The NLTK Library for Advanced
NLP}\label{the-nltk-library-for-advanced-nlp}

\subsubsection{What is NLTK?}\label{what-is-nltk}

\textbf{NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit)} is a comprehensive Python
library for \textbf{natural language processing (NLP)} and \textbf{text
analysis}. It offers tools for tokenization, preprocessing,
part-of-speech tagging, parsing, named-entity recognition, sentiment
analysis, and more---useful from classroom demos to research prototypes.

\subsubsection{Why NLTK Matters in Data
Science}\label{why-nltk-matters-in-data-science}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\textbf{Tokenization: Breaking Text into
Pieces}}{Tokenization: Breaking Text into Pieces}}\label{tokenization-breaking-text-into-pieces}

Tokenization is the foundation of NLP - splitting text into meaningful
units (words, sentences, or phrases).

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🔤 Tokenization Examples: Word and Sentence Level}
\ImportTok{from}\NormalTok{ nltk.tokenize }\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ word\_tokenize, sent\_tokenize}
\ImportTok{from}\NormalTok{ nltk.tokenize }\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ RegexpTokenizer, WhitespaceTokenizer}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ pandas }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ pd}

\CommentTok{\# Sample text for demonstration}
\NormalTok{sample\_text }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"""}
\StringTok{Natural Language Processing (NLP) is amazing! It helps computers understand human language.}
\StringTok{Companies like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft use NLP for various applications.}
\StringTok{Did you know that NLTK has been around since 2001? It\textquotesingle{}s a powerful toolkit.}
\StringTok{Let\textquotesingle{}s explore tokenization: word{-}level, sentence{-}level, and custom patterns.}
\StringTok{"""}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"📝 Original Text:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(sample\_text.strip())}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{"} \OperatorTok{+} \StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{60}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🔤 TOKENIZATION EXAMPLES"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{60}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# 1. SENTENCE TOKENIZATION}
\NormalTok{sentences }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sent\_tokenize(sample\_text)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{📄 Sentence Tokenization (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(sentences)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ sentences):"}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i, sentence }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{enumerate}\NormalTok{(sentences, }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{):}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"  }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{i}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{. }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{sentence}\SpecialCharTok{.}\NormalTok{strip()}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# 2. WORD TOKENIZATION  }
\NormalTok{words }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ word\_tokenize(sample\_text)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🔤 Word Tokenization (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(words)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ tokens):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"First 15 tokens:"}\NormalTok{, words[:}\DecValTok{15}\NormalTok{])}

\CommentTok{\# 3. CUSTOM TOKENIZATION}
\CommentTok{\# Only alphabetic tokens (removes punctuation and numbers)}
\NormalTok{alpha\_tokenizer }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ RegexpTokenizer(}\VerbatimStringTok{r\textquotesingle{}[a{-}zA{-}Z]+\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{alpha\_tokens }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ alpha\_tokenizer.tokenize(sample\_text)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🔤 Alphabetic Only (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(alpha\_tokens)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ tokens):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"First 15 tokens:"}\NormalTok{, alpha\_tokens[:}\DecValTok{15}\NormalTok{])}

\CommentTok{\# 4. WHITESPACE TOKENIZATION}
\NormalTok{whitespace\_tokenizer }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ WhitespaceTokenizer()}
\NormalTok{whitespace\_tokens }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ whitespace\_tokenizer.tokenize(sample\_text)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🔤 Whitespace Tokenization (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(whitespace\_tokens)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ tokens):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"First 10 tokens:"}\NormalTok{, whitespace\_tokens[:}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{])}

\CommentTok{\# Create DataFrame for comparison}
\NormalTok{tokenization\_comparison }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(\{}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Method\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Sentences\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Words (with punct.)\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Alphabetic only\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Whitespace\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Token\_Count\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(sentences), }\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(words), }\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(alpha\_tokens), }\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(whitespace\_tokens)],}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Sample\_Tokens\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: [}
\NormalTok{        [s[:}\DecValTok{30}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \StringTok{"..."} \ControlFlowTok{if} \BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(s) }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{30} \ControlFlowTok{else}\NormalTok{ s }\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ s }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ sentences[:}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]],}
\NormalTok{        words[:}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{],}
\NormalTok{        alpha\_tokens[:}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{], }
\NormalTok{        whitespace\_tokens[:}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{]}
\NormalTok{    ]}
\NormalTok{\})}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{📊 Tokenization Comparison:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(tokenization\_comparison.to\_string(index}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{False}\NormalTok{))}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\begin{verbatim}
📝 Original Text:
Natural Language Processing (NLP) is amazing! It helps computers understand human language.
Companies like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft use NLP for various applications.
Did you know that NLTK has been around since 2001? It's a powerful toolkit.
Let's explore tokenization: word-level, sentence-level, and custom patterns.

============================================================
🔤 TOKENIZATION EXAMPLES
============================================================

📄 Sentence Tokenization (6 sentences):
  1. Natural Language Processing (NLP) is amazing!
  2. It helps computers understand human language.
  3. Companies like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft use NLP for various applications.
  4. Did you know that NLTK has been around since 2001?
  5. It's a powerful toolkit.
  6. Let's explore tokenization: word-level, sentence-level, and custom patterns.

🔤 Word Tokenization (60 tokens):
First 15 tokens: ['Natural', 'Language', 'Processing', '(', 'NLP', ')', 'is', 'amazing', '!', 'It', 'helps', 'computers', 'understand', 'human', 'language']

🔤 Alphabetic Only (48 tokens):
First 15 tokens: ['Natural', 'Language', 'Processing', 'NLP', 'is', 'amazing', 'It', 'helps', 'computers', 'understand', 'human', 'language', 'Companies', 'like', 'Google']

🔤 Whitespace Tokenization (45 tokens):
First 10 tokens: ['Natural', 'Language', 'Processing', '(NLP)', 'is', 'amazing!', 'It', 'helps', 'computers', 'understand']

📊 Tokenization Comparison:
             Method  Token_Count                                                           Sample_Tokens
          Sentences            6 [\nNatural Language Processing (..., It helps computers understand ...]
Words (with punct.)           60                                         [Natural, Language, Processing]
    Alphabetic only           48                                         [Natural, Language, Processing]
         Whitespace           45                                         [Natural, Language, Processing]
\end{verbatim}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\textbf{Text Preprocessing: Stop Words
and
Cleaning}}{Text Preprocessing: Stop Words and Cleaning}}\label{text-preprocessing-stop-words-and-cleaning}

Stop words are common words that typically don't carry significant
meaning and are often removed to focus on important content.

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🧹 Stop Words and Text Cleaning}
\ImportTok{from}\NormalTok{ nltk.corpus }\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ stopwords}
\ImportTok{from}\NormalTok{ nltk.tokenize }\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ word\_tokenize}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ string}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ pandas }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ pd}

\CommentTok{\# Sample product reviews for analysis}
\NormalTok{product\_reviews }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
    \StringTok{"This product is absolutely amazing! I love it so much."}\NormalTok{,}
    \StringTok{"The quality is terrible. I want my money back immediately."}\NormalTok{,  }
    \StringTok{"It\textquotesingle{}s okay, nothing special but does the job well enough."}\NormalTok{,}
    \StringTok{"Fantastic value for money! Highly recommend to everyone."}\NormalTok{,}
    \StringTok{"Poor customer service and the product broke after one day."}
\NormalTok{]}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🛍️ Sample Product Reviews:"}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i, review }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{enumerate}\NormalTok{(product\_reviews, }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{):}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"  }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{i}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{. }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{review}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\StringTok{"} \OperatorTok{+} \StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{60}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🧹 TEXT PREPROCESSING PIPELINE"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{60}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Get English stop words}
\NormalTok{stop\_words }\OperatorTok{=} \BuiltInTok{set}\NormalTok{(stopwords.words(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}english\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{))}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{📋 English Stop Words (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(stop\_words)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ words):"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"Sample stop words:"}\NormalTok{, }\BuiltInTok{sorted}\NormalTok{(}\BuiltInTok{list}\NormalTok{(stop\_words))[:}\DecValTok{20}\NormalTok{])}

\KeywordTok{def}\NormalTok{ preprocess\_text(text):}
    \CommentTok{"""Complete text preprocessing pipeline"""}
    
    \CommentTok{\# 1. Convert to lowercase}
\NormalTok{    text }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ text.lower()}
    
    \CommentTok{\# 2. Tokenize}
\NormalTok{    tokens }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ word\_tokenize(text)}
    
    \CommentTok{\# 3. Remove punctuation and non{-}alphabetic tokens}
\NormalTok{    tokens }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [token }\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ token }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ tokens }\ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ token.isalpha()]}
    
    \CommentTok{\# 4. Remove stop words}
\NormalTok{    filtered\_tokens }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [token }\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ token }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ tokens }\ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ token }\KeywordTok{not} \KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ stop\_words]}
    
    \ControlFlowTok{return}\NormalTok{ tokens, filtered\_tokens}

\CommentTok{\# Process all reviews}
\NormalTok{processed\_reviews }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ []}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🔍 Processing Each Review:"}\NormalTok{)}
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ i, review }\KeywordTok{in} \BuiltInTok{enumerate}\NormalTok{(product\_reviews, }\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{):}
\NormalTok{    original\_tokens, filtered\_tokens }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ preprocess\_text(review)}
    
\NormalTok{    processed\_reviews.append(\{}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Review\_ID\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\SpecialStringTok{f\textquotesingle{}Review\_}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{i}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{,}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Original\_Text\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: review,}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Original\_Tokens\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(original\_tokens),}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}After\_Cleaning\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(filtered\_tokens),}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Tokens\_Removed\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: }\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(original\_tokens) }\OperatorTok{{-}} \BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(filtered\_tokens),}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Key\_Words\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: filtered\_tokens[:}\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{]  }\CommentTok{\# First 5 meaningful words}
\NormalTok{    \})}
    
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{  📝 Review }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{i}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{:"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"     Original: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{review}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"     Key words: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{filtered\_tokens[:}\DecValTok{8}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"     Tokens: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(original\_tokens)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ → }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(filtered\_tokens)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ ({-}}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(original\_tokens) }\OperatorTok{{-}} \BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(filtered\_tokens)}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{)"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Create summary DataFrame}
\NormalTok{df\_preprocessing }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(processed\_reviews)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{📊 Preprocessing Summary:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(df\_preprocessing[[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Review\_ID\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Original\_Tokens\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}After\_Cleaning\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Tokens\_Removed\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]].to\_string(index}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{False}\NormalTok{))}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{📈 Overall Statistics:"}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{total\_original }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_preprocessing[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Original\_Tokens\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{sum}\NormalTok{()}
\NormalTok{total\_cleaned }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_preprocessing[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}After\_Cleaning\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].}\BuiltInTok{sum}\NormalTok{()}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• Total tokens before cleaning: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{total\_original}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• Total tokens after cleaning: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{total\_cleaned}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• Tokens removed: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{total\_original }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ total\_cleaned}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ (}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{((total\_original }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ total\_cleaned)}\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{total\_original)}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{100}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{\%)"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• Average tokens per review (cleaned): }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{total\_cleaned}\OperatorTok{/}\BuiltInTok{len}\NormalTok{(product\_reviews)}\SpecialCharTok{:.1f\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\begin{verbatim}
🛍️ Sample Product Reviews:
  1. This product is absolutely amazing! I love it so much.
  2. The quality is terrible. I want my money back immediately.
  3. It's okay, nothing special but does the job well enough.
  4. Fantastic value for money! Highly recommend to everyone.
  5. Poor customer service and the product broke after one day.

============================================================
🧹 TEXT PREPROCESSING PIPELINE
============================================================

📋 English Stop Words (198 words):
Sample stop words: ['a', 'about', 'above', 'after', 'again', 'against', 'ain', 'all', 'am', 'an', 'and', 'any', 'are', 'aren', "aren't", 'as', 'at', 'be', 'because', 'been']

🔍 Processing Each Review:

  📝 Review 1:
     Original: This product is absolutely amazing! I love it so much.
     Key words: ['product', 'absolutely', 'amazing', 'love', 'much']
     Tokens: 10 → 5 (-5)

  📝 Review 2:
     Original: The quality is terrible. I want my money back immediately.
     Key words: ['quality', 'terrible', 'want', 'money', 'back', 'immediately']
     Tokens: 10 → 6 (-4)

  📝 Review 3:
     Original: It's okay, nothing special but does the job well enough.
     Key words: ['okay', 'nothing', 'special', 'job', 'well', 'enough']
     Tokens: 10 → 6 (-4)

  📝 Review 4:
     Original: Fantastic value for money! Highly recommend to everyone.
     Key words: ['fantastic', 'value', 'money', 'highly', 'recommend', 'everyone']
     Tokens: 8 → 6 (-2)

  📝 Review 5:
     Original: Poor customer service and the product broke after one day.
     Key words: ['poor', 'customer', 'service', 'product', 'broke', 'one', 'day']
     Tokens: 10 → 7 (-3)

📊 Preprocessing Summary:
Review_ID  Original_Tokens  After_Cleaning  Tokens_Removed
 Review_1               10               5               5
 Review_2               10               6               4
 Review_3               10               6               4
 Review_4                8               6               2
 Review_5               10               7               3

📈 Overall Statistics:

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\textbf{Stemming and Lemmatization:
Finding Word
Roots}}{Stemming and Lemmatization: Finding Word Roots}}\label{stemming-and-lemmatization-finding-word-roots}

Both stemming and lemmatization reduce words to their base form, but
they work differently: - \textbf{Stemming}: Fast, rule-based chopping
(running → run) - \textbf{Lemmatization}: Slower, dictionary-based
reduction (better → good)

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# 🌱 Stemming vs Lemmatization Comparison}
\ImportTok{from}\NormalTok{ nltk.stem }\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ PorterStemmer, SnowballStemmer}
\ImportTok{from}\NormalTok{ nltk.stem }\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ WordNetLemmatizer}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ pandas }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ pd}

\CommentTok{\# Initialize stemmers and lemmatizer}
\NormalTok{porter }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ PorterStemmer()}
\NormalTok{snowball }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ SnowballStemmer(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}english\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)  }
\NormalTok{lemmatizer }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ WordNetLemmatizer()}

\CommentTok{\# Test words that demonstrate differences}
\NormalTok{test\_words }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}running\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}runs\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}ran\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}runner\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{,        }\CommentTok{\# Run variations}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}better\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}good\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}best\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{,                  }\CommentTok{\# Good variations  }
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}dogs\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}cats\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}children\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}geese\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{,      }\CommentTok{\# Plural forms}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}walking\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}walked\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}walks\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{,             }\CommentTok{\# Walk variations}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}flying\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}flies\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}flew\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{,                }\CommentTok{\# Fly variations}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}studies\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}studying\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}studied\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{,         }\CommentTok{\# Study variations}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}beautiful\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}beautifully\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{,               }\CommentTok{\# Adjective/adverb}
    \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}happiness\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}happier\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}happiest\textquotesingle{}}        \CommentTok{\# Happy variations}
\NormalTok{]}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"🌱 STEMMING vs LEMMATIZATION COMPARISON"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"="}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{60}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Process each word}
\NormalTok{results }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ []}
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ word }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ test\_words:}
\NormalTok{    porter\_stem }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ porter.stem(word)}
\NormalTok{    snowball\_stem }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ snowball.stem(word) }
\NormalTok{    lemma }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ lemmatizer.lemmatize(word)}
\NormalTok{    lemma\_verb }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ lemmatizer.lemmatize(word, pos}\OperatorTok{=}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}v\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)  }\CommentTok{\# As verb}
    
\NormalTok{    results.append(\{}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Original\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: word,}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Porter\_Stem\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: porter\_stem,}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Snowball\_Stem\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: snowball\_stem,}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Lemma\_Noun\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: lemma,}
        \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Lemma\_Verb\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{: lemma\_verb}
\NormalTok{    \})}

\CommentTok{\# Create comparison DataFrame}
\NormalTok{df\_comparison }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pd.DataFrame(results)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"📊 Detailed Comparison:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(df\_comparison.to\_string(index}\OperatorTok{=}\VariableTok{False}\NormalTok{))}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🎯 Key Differences Analysis:"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Count unique results for each method}
\NormalTok{porter\_unique }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_comparison[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Porter\_Stem\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].nunique()}
\NormalTok{snowball\_unique }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_comparison[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Snowball\_Stem\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].nunique() }
\NormalTok{lemma\_unique }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_comparison[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Lemma\_Noun\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{].nunique()}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• Porter Stemmer: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{porter\_unique}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ unique stems"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• Snowball Stemmer: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{snowball\_unique}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ unique stems"}\NormalTok{) }
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• WordNet Lemmatizer: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{lemma\_unique}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ unique lemmas"}\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{💡 Notable Examples:"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Find interesting cases where methods differ significantly}
\NormalTok{interesting\_cases }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
\NormalTok{    (}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}better\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}good\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{),   }\CommentTok{\# Lemmatization handles irregular forms}
\NormalTok{    (}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}studies\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}study\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{), }\CommentTok{\# Different handling of {-}ies ending}
\NormalTok{    (}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}flying\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}fly\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{),    }\CommentTok{\# Verb vs noun treatment}
\NormalTok{    (}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}geese\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}goose\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)    }\CommentTok{\# Irregular plurals}
\NormalTok{]}

\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ original, expected }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ interesting\_cases:}
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ original }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ test\_words:}
\NormalTok{        row }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ df\_comparison[df\_comparison[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Original\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{ original].iloc[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}
        \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"• \textquotesingle{}}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{original}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{} → Porter: \textquotesingle{}}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Porter\_Stem\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{}, Lemma: \textquotesingle{}}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{row[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}Lemma\_Noun\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{} (expected: \textquotesingle{}}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{expected}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{\textquotesingle{})"}\NormalTok{)}

\CommentTok{\# Real{-}world application example}
\NormalTok{sample\_sentence }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{"The children were running happily through the beautiful gardens, studying the flying geese."}
\NormalTok{words\_to\_process }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sample\_sentence.lower().replace(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{},\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{).replace(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}.\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{, }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{).split()}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{🔬 Real{-}world Example:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"Sentence: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{sample\_sentence}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{Word processing:"}\NormalTok{)}

\NormalTok{sentence\_results }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ []}
\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ word }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ words\_to\_process:}
    \ControlFlowTok{if}\NormalTok{ word.isalpha():  }\CommentTok{\# Skip punctuation}
\NormalTok{        stem }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ porter.stem(word)}
\NormalTok{        lemma }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ lemmatizer.lemmatize(word)}
\NormalTok{        sentence\_results.append(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{word}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{ → stem: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{stem}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{, lemma: }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{lemma}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\ControlFlowTok{for}\NormalTok{ result }\KeywordTok{in}\NormalTok{ sentence\_results[:}\DecValTok{6}\NormalTok{]:  }\CommentTok{\# Show first 6 words}
    \BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"  }\SpecialCharTok{\{}\NormalTok{result}\SpecialCharTok{\}}\SpecialStringTok{"}\NormalTok{)}

\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\SpecialStringTok{f"}\CharTok{\textbackslash{}n}\SpecialStringTok{⚡ Performance Guidelines:"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"• Use STEMMING when: Speed is crucial, approximate matching is okay"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"• Use LEMMATIZATION when: Accuracy is important, working with formal text"}\NormalTok{)}
\BuiltInTok{print}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{"• Stemming is \textasciitilde{}10x faster but less accurate than lemmatization"}\NormalTok{)}
\end{Highlighting}
